title: Comparison of the normalized degree-one Tate object with the finite-root line
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and fix the adopted-source normalized Tate datum with the following meaning: its degree-one object is a locally constant finite rank-one sheaf placed in degree zero, its derived pullback comparisons are coherent, and it underlies natural multiplicative Kummer classes whose coordinate boundary has invertible exceptional adjunct over every separated finite-type scheme over a field. Let $N>0$ satisfy $N\Lambda=0$, and let $X$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme] on which $N$ is invertible. In the ordinary unbounded etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], there exists an isomorphism $\Lambda_X(1)\cong (\mu_{N,X}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}\Lambda_X)[0]$, with the concrete right-hand sheaf defined by [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. Only the degree-one object is compared; no adjunction, trace, or compatibility with a selected Kummer class is asserted.

source.place: Comparison of the normalized degree-one Tate object with the finite-root line; refinement of lem-normalized-projective-line-adjunction proof step 1 or 2.

proof.text: Construct the normal integral Noetherian universal base Spec(ULift Z)[1/N]. Both coefficient lines on it are locally constant: one by the given Tate datum, the other by the primitive-root trivializing cover. The localization universal property gives X -> V. This also covers N=1 and the zero coefficient ring.

Apply lem-sp-normalized-tate-line-over-field to the generic stalk field of V. Transport through the given Tate-object pullback and the finite-root pullback comparison. Full faithfulness of the degree-zero single functor yields an isomorphism between the generic pullbacks of the two sheaves.

The actual generic-point adjunction units on both locally constant sheaves are isomorphisms by lem-sp-normal-generic-locally-constant-unit. Compose the first unit, direct image of the generic comparison, and the inverse second unit. Apply single0, then pull back along X -> V and compose the Tate pullback comparison, the single0/pullback comparison, and the finite-root pullback comparison.

proof_origin.place: Y8: the universal-base, generic-field comparison and adjunction-unit descent argument, with both new intermediate theorems fully proved.

mathlib_searches.results: Cyclotomic characters for the coefficient comparison; ordinary Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction and SheafOfModules pullback adjunctions for the diagonal kernel. None has this statement.

No comparison/kernel names in Mathlib. Projective adjunction hits concern projective objects. Repository has a Noetherian concrete P1 adjunction, arbitrary-base splitting/integrals and an affine-base trace adjunction; none has this interface.

theorem nonempty_normalizedTateLineComparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] [HasTateTwist Λ]
    [HasTateTwist.IsNormalized Λ] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hΛ : (N : Λ) = 0)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasInvertibleExponent Λ X] (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    Nonempty (tateObject Λ X 1 ≅
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X N Λ hΛ))
